violations.message: Function 'func_internal' defined without a visible prototype.
violations.reason: Function 'func_internal' has external linkage but no visible prototype declaration in this translation unit.
violations.suggested_fix:
int func_internal(void);
int func_internal(void) { return global_single_use; }

patch_preview.replacement_source:
int func_internal(void);
int func_internal(void) { return global_single_use; }
patch_preview.explanation: MISRA Rule 8.4 — Function defined with external linkage but missing a visible prototype declaration. The automated patch prepends the prototype declaration 'int func_internal(void);' immediately before the function definition.
patch_preview.proposed_snippet:
int func_internal(void);
int func_internal(void) { return global_single_use; }
